    Bongartz's Theorem 6 from its remaining steps #

    BongartzDistributive follows from three statements about the small model P of the ray category of a distributive minimal representation-infinite algebra B (bongartzDistributive_of_nodes):

    • AlgebraIsLinearization: B ≅ k(P);
    • CrownCase: if P is not chain-bounded, its fundamental group is free (the chain-bounded case is Fischbacher's theorem, proved in FundamentalGroups/Basic/FreePi.lean);
    • CoverDichotomy: given B ≅ k(P) and a torsion-free fundamental group, a finite convex piece of the universal cover carries a Kronecker pair respecting the relations of the cover, or B has a monomial band.

    The covering data are then built by RayCat.pairCoveringData.
